text.en:
Revocation of EO No. 183. EO No. 183 creating the NIR is
hereby revoked. The provinces of Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental shall
revert to Region VI and Region VII, respectively.

Abolition of the NIR Regional Offices (ROs) and Regional
Councils (RCs). RCs established by EO No. 183 and ROs created pursuant to
Memorandum Circular No. 81 (s. 2015) are hereby abolished. All existing personnel
of the NIR ROs shall return to their previous units of deployment, or reassigned to
other offices within their respective departments/agencies.
The winding up of the operations of the NIR ROs, as well as the final
disposition (e.g., transfer or abolition) of their functions, positions, personnel, assets
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

and liabilities, shall be done immediately and completed not later than sixty (60) days
from the effectivity of this Order.

Supervision by the Department of the Interior and Local
Government. The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) is
hereby directed to supervise the reversion of Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental
provinces to Regions VI and VII, respectively. The DILG may, as necessary, issue
guidelines for the reversion of the NIR and abolition of the RCs and ROs.

Role of Other Government Agencies. All other departments,
bureaus, offices, agencies, and instrumentalities of the national government,
including government-owned or -controlled corporations and government financial
institutions, are hereby directed to extend their full assistance to the DILG in the
reversion process.

Repealing Clause. All orders, proclamations, rules, regulations,
and issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Order are
hereby repealed, amended, or modified accordingly.

Separability Clause. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
Shall remain in full force or effect.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect upon publication in a
newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 7th day of
the vear of our Lord Two Thousand and Seventeen.
By the President:
Rotatorets,
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINE
